messages:
jamie: Nightcap shift here — quick async check. What I did: rolled back modelserver v0.9.4 -> v0.9.3 on pool-asia-1 after OOMs; started regen consumer scale-up.
ravi: Saw memory leak when seq_len >2048, reproducer added. Rolled restart remaining nodes in pool-asia-1. :thumbsup:
emily: Regen backlog ~1200 when I started. scaled workers x2, drain job running; currently ~600 left. Command run: `python tools/regen_drain.py --limit 300`
deploy-bot: deploy notice — rollback complete: modelserver v0.9.3 on pool-asia-1 at 4312345701 :white_check_mark:
sarah: kvcache evictions spiking in eu-west1 (evict rate ~18%). Bumped kvcache to 110% and rebalanced. Evictions down ~28% in last 10m.
pagerduty-bot: pager duty — OOMs triggered PD alert at 4312345600, escalation acknowledged by jamie.
jamie: Mitigations: 1) rollback done; 2) regen workers scaled; 3) kvcache bump. Observability: added temporary dashboard card for pool-asia memory and regen backlog.
ravi: PR opened for mem test + fix: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4321 — need emily review.
emily: I'll review in ~30m. Keeping worker scale for 2h and watching error budgets.
jamie: Next steps: schedule canary for v0.9.5 with leak patch, add mem regression test to CI, and adjust alert thresholds for kv eviction. Blockers: need temporary quota bump in eu-west1 if backlog doesn't shrink — flagged finance.
paul: noted. If backlog crosses 1200 again we should enable the fallback small-model routing policy (`routing.fallback=small-model`) to preserve latency.
jamie: No other incidents. Will monitor and post another update when regen <=100. Thanks team — handoff complete. :pray:
